title: Ontario Energy Board Proceeding EB-2026-0129 — Phase 65 Toronto application 24 254930 delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Toronto application 24 254930 delivery reporting pack. The OEB docket records Toronto Hydro's application for a proposed non-wires-solutions incentive mechanism, followed by acknowledgment, procedural orders, participation records, and July interrogatories without a substantive decision.
key_findings: Toronto Hydro proposes an incentive mechanism covering eligible non-wires solutions from May 1, 2026 through December 31, 2029.
The OEB acknowledged the application in April and issued procedural orders governing the proceeding.
The docket contained July 14-15 interrogatory records, showing an active evidentiary process rather than a concluded approval.
why_it_matters: Which records separate Council adoption and infrastructure context from enactment, conditions, building permit, start, completion, and occupancy? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The case provides a named regulatory trail for how Toronto distribution planning may evaluate non-wires alternatives, costs, incentives, and evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a specific OEB proceeding to the Ontario local-conversion stack.
Creates a docket path from application through evidence, hearing, decision, implementation, and measured system results.
Connects distribution capacity, demand management, finance, and regulation.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
An application and procedural record are not an OEB approval or final incentive design.
The proceeding does not prove that a particular non-wires solution will be selected, deployed, or effective.
No project-level capacity, cost, schedule, customer, or performance outcome should be inferred before later records.
